title: Night Before the Storm
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji stepped onto the battlefield of destiny, the golden light of the complete Tianji Record tore through the sky—the ultimate confrontation between Heaven's Way and humanity is about to begin.

text.content: The cold snort from the nine heavens still echoed, shaking the countless stars in the sky. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back at the Cliff Edge, his robes flapping violently in the fierce wind, yet his deep eyes remained as calm as an ancient well. The Heavenly Eye's fury? Hmph, merely a chess player discovering he is no longer the only chess player on the board. His lips curved slightly, voice cold yet penetrating the clouds: 'Since Heaven's Way wishes to watch a show, then I shall perform for it—until it steps onto the stage itself.'

dialogue.content: "How composed you are." Su Qingyao's figure descended like a startled swan beside Chen Ji, frost gathering between her brows. Gazing at the shattered corner of the sky, a cold smile formed on her lips, "The Heavenly Eye has made its move. It seems every action of ours is under its surveillance. Chen Ji, are you certain you wish to continue this gamble?"

text.content: Chen Ji turned, his gaze lingering momentarily on Su Qingyao's cold visage. Moonlight poured down, silvering her in its glow, yet also revealing the exhaustion and worry hidden in her eyes. He suddenly laughed lightly: "Su Qingyao, when did you start caring about a废物?" His tone was teasing, but his eyes held a trace of seriousness. "Rest assured, my life isn't yet due to end."

dialogue.content: "A废物?" A languid laugh echoed from the shadows as Ye Qing strolled out from the void, demonic energy swirling around her like graceful ribbons. "If you're a废物, then what the world calls genius would be nothing but the mud beneath a废物的 feet." She cast a sidelong glance at Su Qingyao with sultry eyes, "Sister Su is so tense—anyone might think you two have some secret affair."

choice.prompt: Just as the two beauties exchanged barbs, Chen Ji sensed a disturbance from afar—the Heavenly Eye was beginning to mobilize higher-dimensional forces. He had to make an immediate decision and summon all allies for the final strategic deployment.

choices.text: Gather all members, reveal all hidden cards
choices.description: Gathering all allies at the Tianji Hall, Chen Ji decided to withhold nothing, displaying the power of the complete Tianji Record to everyone for the final strategic deployment.
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Eye will obtain complete intelligence

text.content: Chen Ji raised his hand, and a streak of golden light shot from his brow center, forming an ancient medallion that hovered in mid-air. On its surface, the patterns of the Tianji Record flowed ceaselessly, as if resonating with something. "Everyone, since Heaven's Way has shown its fangs, there's no need for us to hide anymore." He surveyed his surroundings, voice steady yet commanding undeniable authority, "Three quarters of an hour later, assembly at the Tianji Hall. Latecomers will face military discipline."

dialogue.content: The laughter of the remnant soul Mo Xiansheng echoed from the medallion, carrying waves of relief and emotion: "Excellent, excellent, excellent! Young master has finally taken this step! The complete Tianji Record shall finally see the light of day!"

choices.text: Split up and act, each defending key points
choices.description: Chen Ji decided on dispersed deployment, having allies each guard critical nodes to counter potential multi-directional attacks from the Heavenly Eye.
choices.risk_hint: Individual combat power may be defeated one by one

text.content: A sharp glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as his fingers traced a complex formation diagram in the void. On the diagram, seven points of light flickered, each corresponding to a strategic location. "The Heavenly Eye will not attack from just one direction." His voice was calm yet certain, "Su Qingyao guards the Tianji Hall's core, Ye Qing takes the Demonic Path entrance, and I—" he paused, "I will be in everyone's blind spot, playing the piece no one would anticipate."

choices.text: Lure the snake out of its hole, set a trap
choices.description: Chen Ji planned to use himself as bait, actively revealing his position to lure the Heavenly Eye's reinforcements into a trap, weakening the enemy's effective strength before the final battle.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Ji will face extreme danger
choices.risk_hint: May fall right into the enemy's schemes

dialogue.content: "Are you insane!" Su Qingyao grabbed Chen Ji's sleeve, rare panic and fury flickering in her eyes. "Do you think the Heavenly Eye is some joke? Those higher-dimensional beings are not something you can handle! Chen Ji, stop this self-righteous arrogance of yours!"

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his gaze to Su Qingyao's tightly clenched hand, a meaningful smile curving his lips. He didn't pull away; instead, he gently patted the back of her hand: "Senior Su, rest assured. I never fight a battle without certainty." He raised his other hand, and a yellowed page slipped from his sleeve—the final page of the Tianji Record, its tattered edges emanating a faint yet chilling glow. "This time, victory is mine."

Three quarters of an hour later, the Tianji Hall blazed with lights. As Chen Ji stepped into the great hall, he found everyone had already assembled—Su Qingyao standing at the left chief seat, Ye Qing lounging against a pillar in the corner, her demonic eyes swirling with playful light. And at the hall's center, a phantom figure waited silently: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul projection, cradling an ancient yellowed scroll in his hands. "Young Master," Mo Xiansheng's voice rasped, aged and hoarse, "the complete Tianji Record, I can finally hand to you myself."

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng slowly unfurled the scroll, and in an instant, the entire hall was bathed in soft golden light. Chen Ji's pupils contracted as he beheld countless runes flowing across the scroll like a river of stars, each rune brimming with world-altering power. "The Tianji Record comprises nine volumes," Mo Xiansheng's voice trembled slightly. "What you previously obtained were merely fragments of the first three volumes. Now—" He raised his hand, and seven beams of light flew from the scroll, diving into Chen Ji's brow center, hands, feet, heart, and dantian. "The complete Tianji Record is finally whole!"

text.content: Agony and ecstasy collided simultaneously. Chen Ji felt every inch of skin burning while endless knowledge flooded his consciousness. He witnessed the past—the rise and fall of generations of seers; the present—the Heavenly Eye's vast awareness network operating at frantic speed; and the future—countless threads of destiny weaving together, ultimately converging into an outcome that chilled even his heart. Yet he did not retreat; instead, he laughed through the searing pain: "So this is it! This is the true face of the Tianji Record!"

choice.prompt: The moment Chen Ji fused with the complete Tianji Record, a sinister fluctuation rippled from the highest heavens. The Heavenly Eye seemed to sense something, beginning to summon reinforcements from higher dimensions. An oppressive pressure poured from the celestial dome, causing even Su Qingyao and Ye Qing to change expression.

choices.text: Strike instead of defend, seize the initiative
choices.description: Chen Ji decided to strike first while the Heavenly Eye's reinforcements had not yet fully descended, interrupting the summoning ritual and disrupting the enemy's deployment.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a massive amount of Heavenly Fate
choices.visible_reward: Interrupt enemy summoning, seize strategic initiative
choices.risk_hint: May expose all abilities of the complete Tianji Record

text.content: Golden light blazed in Chen Ji's eyes as he formed a seal with one hand, a brilliant pillar of light erupting from his palm toward the heavens. Where the pillar passed, the void shattered like glass, revealing the chaotic expanse beyond. Within that void, countless eyes opened from the darkness—beings summoned by the Heavenly Eye from higher dimensions, each radiating a despair-inducing pressure. Yet Chen Ji showed no fear; instead, he coldly laughed: "Think you can overwhelm me with numbers? Dream on!"

choices.text: Remain still to counter movement, wait patiently for the opportune moment
choices.description: Chen Ji decided to hold his position, using the complete Tianji Record's foresight to observe the enemy reinforcements' weaknesses before making a decision.

dialogue.content: "Everyone, stay still." Chen Ji raised his hand, halting the restless crowd. The golden light in his eyes burned even brighter. The power of the complete Tianji Record circulated through him, allowing him to perceive more fragments of heavenly secrets. After a moment, a cold smile curled his lips: "So that's it. The reinforcements the Heavenly Eye summons from higher dimensions are not without cost—they require a medium. And this medium lies..." His gaze pierced through multiple layers of void, falling upon a certain direction: "The Xuanwu Sect."

choices.text: Unite with Ye Qing, together construct a mist formation
choices.description: Chen Ji decided to join forces with Ye Qing, using her demonic mist to conceal the Tianji Record's aura while conducting secret deployments under the Heavenly Eye's surveillance.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a massive amount of Ye Qing's demonic energy
choices.visible_reward: Deceive the Heavenly Eye, complete the secret formation
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may become exhausted as a result

dialogue.content: A flicker of surprise crossed Ye Qing's eyes, then transformed into a knowing smile. She slowly walked to Chen Ji's side, extending her hand to interlock fingers with his. In an instant, thick demonic energy surged from within her, intertwining with Chen Ji's golden light to form a mist impenetrable even to the Heavenly Eye. "Chen Ji," her voice was low and serious, "you owe me a significant favor."

text.content: Within the mist, Chen Ji's voice clearly reached everyone's ears: "Since Heaven wants to see my trump card, I'll show it—show it an outcome it absolutely cannot anticipate." His plan surged forth like a tide, every detail meticulously precise: "Han Lie will betray Heaven at the crucial moment, Ling Yuan's ambition will become our finest blade, and Chen Nian..." He paused, a subtle tenderness threading through his voice, "I will bring her back."

As various forces secretly vied for power, a massive crack suddenly tore open in the depths of the heavens. Through the fissure, a scene beyond mortal comprehension came into view—a higher dimensional world where countless twisted figures writhed within, emanating a despair-inducing pressure that seemed ready to pour down at any moment. Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist trembled violently under this pressure, her face instantly draining of color: "What... what are these things?"

dialogue.content: "Those are the eyes of Heaven's Dao." Mo Xiansheng's voice was rarely grave, "To be precise, they are pieces placed by the Eye of Heavenly Dao across different dimensions. They are not bound by this world's rules, and their arrival brings catastrophic devastation. Young master, you must stop them, or else—" He didn't finish, but everyone understood what that unfinished ending implied.

text.content: Chen Ji stared at the fissure, his eyes gleaming with sharp light. The complete Tianji Record roared within him, countless pieces of information flooding into his mind like a torrent. He glimpsed the weakness of these higher dimensional beings—despite their immense power, they must cling to some "anchor point" to descend stably. And that anchor point was precisely the spokesperson chosen by the Eye of Heavenly Dao in this world. A cold smile tugged at the corner of his mouth: "It seems our old friend Ling Yuan is about to make another appearance."

choice.prompt: With the final battle imminent, Chen Ji had to make one last decision before combat began—whether to confess everything to his allies, letting them face death with clear understanding, or to shoulder all secrets alone, granting them a battlefield without regrets?

choices.text: Confess openly and share life and death together
choices.description: Chen Ji decided to reveal his true identity, the secrets of the complete Tianji Record, and the ultimate truth of this war to everyone, allowing them to face the final battle with clear understanding.
choices.risk_hint: The truth may exceed what people can bear

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and slowly spoke: "You may have already guessed that I'm not a waste." His voice was calm, yet it thundered through the great hall like a startling thunderclap, "I am the inheritor of the Tianji Record, destined to be an enemy of the Eye of Heavenly Dao. This path will likely lead to death, but—" He looked at Su Qingyao and Ye Qing, rare softness flickering in his eyes, "Fighting shoulder to shoulder with you is the greatest fortune of my life."

choices.text: Bear it alone and fight to the end
choices.description: Chen Ji decided not to reveal the entire truth, only giving allies simple combat instructions, letting them walk toward the battlefield with trust rather than fear.
choices.risk_hint: Allies may make mistakes at critical moments due to lack of information

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao suddenly stepped forward, grabbing Chen Ji's wrist with force almost enough to crush his bones. "Chen Ji," her voice was extremely low, yet carried undeniable firmness, "You'd better not be hiding anything from me. Otherwise—" Her eyes slightly reddened, but her words were cold as ice, "I'll kill you with my own hands."

text.content: Silence filled the great hall, only the night wind pouring through the windows, causing the candlelight to flicker uncertainly. Chen Ji looked at Su Qingyao's reddened eyes, then suddenly reached out and covered her hand on his wrist, gently patting it. "Relax," his voice low and gentle, "This time, I won't hide anything from you." He paused, a self-mocking smile curling at his lips, "After all, there's a woman threatening to kill me every day, I should at least give her an explanation."

dialogue.content: "Hm." Ye Qing laughed lightly, breaking this moment of warmth, "Chen Ji, this devoted and affectionate look of yours, don't forget there's still a tough battle to fight outside." She turned to face the heavens, her gaze becoming sharp, "The Eye of Heavenly Dao's reinforcements have begun descending. If we don't decide soon, it will be too late."

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his hand, his expression turning cold and stern. He turned to gaze at the heavens, where the fissure was expanding visibly. Those twisted higher dimensional beings had already extended their tendrils. His eyes burned with fierce battle intent, his voice ringing like metal striking stone: "Since it's come to this—" He raised his hand, and the power of the complete Tianji Record erupted around him, golden light soaring to the heavens, enveloping the entire Heavenly Secrets Hall, "Then let us fight! This battle—either Heaven's Dao destroys me, or I destroy Heaven's Dao!"

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao and Ye Qing exchanged a glance, simultaneously seeing the same determination in each other's eyes. Su Qingyao drew the sword at her waist, sword qi surging to the skies; Ye Qing formed seals with both hands, demonic energy surging like a tide. "Since you're going to defy Heaven," Su Qingyao said coldly, yet a faint smile curved her lips, "I'll accompany you in madness as the senior fellow disciple of Tianqing Sect." Ye Qing laughed wildly: "A Demonic Path Saint consort fighting alongside a mortal genius against Heaven—this drama is精彩 enough!"

text.content: At this critical moment, a thunderous roar suddenly echoed from outside the Heavenly Secrets Hall. A black figure descended from the heavens, crashing heavily onto the plaza in front of the hall, stirring up clouds of dust. When the dust settled, everyone saw the newcomer's face—it was Han Lie, the first genius of Xuanwu Sect! Covered in blood, his breath chaotic, yet his eyes burned with mad radiance. He roared to the heavens: "Chen Ji! The Eye of Heavenly Dao deceived me! It never intended to save the world, but to destroy everything!"

Chen Ji quietly watched the disheveled Han Lie, his eyes showing no surprise. He had long known Han Lie would be used by the Eye of Heavenly Dao, had long calculated this moment's arrival. He walked down the steps, stopping before Han Lie, looking down at this former rival from above: "Han Lie, you've come at the perfect time." His voice was indifferent, yet carried undeniable authority, "Want revenge? Want to wash away your disgrace?" He extended his hand, "Then stand up and fight alongside me—against Heaven!"

Han Lie stared at the hand reaching toward him, complex light flickering in his eyes. His former humiliation, unwillingness, and anger seemed unimportant at this moment. He took a deep breath, grabbing Chen Ji's hand and pulling himself up with its help. "Chen Ji," his voice hoarse yet firm, "This battle, I'll fight it through with you! After slaying the Eye of Heavenly Dao, we'll settle our accounts!" Chen Ji's lips curved slightly upward, gently patting his shoulder: "Good, a promise is a promise." He turned to gaze into the distance, his eyes reflecting the crumbling heavens, "The storm has arrived. Everyone—follow me into the battlefield of destiny!"
